title: [spec-gap][R-ADR-014] RPL DAO-ACK channel_map (root-assigned data channels) not implemented in any stack
description: spec/appendix-design-rationale.md:416: Data channels via hash or root-assigned (RPL DAO-ACK carries channel_map). Hash-based data channels are implemented+tested (CCP-12), but no DAO-ACK in any stack carries a channel map: Rust DAO-ACK carries address assignment only (rust/lichen-rpl/src/address_assignment.rs:385-471; option registry message.rs:71-85 has no channel option); C rpl option registry rpl_messages.h:59-78 has none; python/src/lichen/rpl/ none. The root-published GCP channel_map (rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs:1173, vector gateway_coordination.json:218, consumer python/tests/gateway/test_gcp6_vectors.py:158) is CoAP gateway coordination, not RPL. Related: R-02-013 gateway-assigned channel DIO option not-implemented, flagged for spec simplification (docs/spec-coverage/02-physical-link.md:33). Found during appendix-design-rationale sweep. Suggested: implement a DAO-ACK/DIO channel option, or amend the appendix to name the GCP channel_map as the root-assigned mechanism.
